# Apa itu Go?

## Sejarah Go

Go (dikenal juga sebagai **Golang**) adalah bahasa pemrograman open-source yang dikembangkan oleh **Google** pada tahun **2009**. Bahasa ini dirancang oleh tiga insinyur berbakat:

- **Robert Griesemer** — pengembang kompiler V8 JavaScript dan HotSpot JVM
- **Rob Pike** — co-creator sistem operasi Plan 9 dan UTF-8
- **Ken Thompson** — co-creator Unix dan bahasa pemrograman C

Go lahir dari frustrasi tim Google terhadap kompleksitas C++ ketika membangun sistem berskala sangat besar. Mereka menginginkan bahasa yang cepat dikompilasi, mudah dibaca, namun tetap efisien secara performa.

## Mengapa Memilih Go?

| Keunggulan | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| **Kompilasi Cepat** | Waktu build sangat singkat bahkan untuk proyek besar |
| **Sintaks Sederhana** | Hanya ~25 kata kunci, mudah dibaca dan dipelajari |
| **Concurrency Bawaan** | Goroutine dan channel untuk pemrograman paralel |
| **Garbage Collection** | Manajemen memori otomatis, tidak perlu `malloc/free` |
| **Static Typing** | Error tipe terdeteksi saat kompilasi, bukan saat runtime |
| **Single Binary** | Output satu file executable, sangat mudah di-deploy |

## Siapa yang Menggunakan Go?

Go telah diadopsi oleh banyak perusahaan teknologi terkemuka:

- **Docker** — platform containerisasi terpopuler di dunia, ditulis hampir seluruhnya dalam Go
- **Kubernetes** — sistem orkestrasi container skala enterprise dari Google
- **Uber** — backend layanan ride-hailing yang menangani jutaan request per detik
- **Cloudflare** — infrastruktur CDN dan keamanan internet
- **Dropbox** — layanan penyimpanan cloud

## Perbandingan: Go vs Python vs Java

| Aspek | Go | Python | Java |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kecepatan eksekusi | Sangat cepat | Lambat | Cepat |
| Sintaks | Sederhana | Sangat sederhana | Verbose |
| Concurrency | Goroutine native | GIL (terbatas) | JVM Thread |
| Output build | Native binary | Interpreted | JVM bytecode |
| Tipe data | Statis | Dinamis | Statis |
| Deploy | Satu binary | Butuh Python runtime | Butuh JVM |
| Kurva belajar | Landai | Sangat landai | Curam |

## Program Pertama: Hello World

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
}
```

**Output:**
```
Hello, World!
```

Setiap program Go yang dapat dieksekusi wajib memiliki tiga komponen:
1. `package main` — menandakan ini adalah program yang bisa dijalankan langsung
2. `import` — mengimpor package eksternal yang dibutuhkan
3. `func main()` — fungsi utama sebagai titik masuk (entry point) program

# What is Go?

## History of Go

Go (also known as **Golang**) is an open-source programming language developed by **Google** in **2009**. It was designed by three talented engineers:

- **Robert Griesemer** — worked on the V8 JavaScript compiler and HotSpot JVM
- **Rob Pike** — co-creator of the Plan 9 operating system and UTF-8
- **Ken Thompson** — co-creator of Unix and the C programming language

Go was born out of frustration with the complexity of C++ when building Google's large-scale systems. They wanted a language that compiled quickly, was easy to read, yet remained highly performant.

## Why Choose Go?

| Advantage | Description |
|---|---|
| **Fast Compilation** | Very short build times, even for large projects |
| **Simple Syntax** | Only ~25 keywords, easy to read and learn |
| **Built-in Concurrency** | Goroutines and channels for parallel programming |
| **Garbage Collection** | Automatic memory management, no `malloc/free` needed |
| **Static Typing** | Type errors caught at compile time, not at runtime |
| **Single Binary** | Produces one executable file, extremely easy to deploy |

## Who Uses Go?

Go has been adopted by many leading technology companies:

- **Docker** — the world's most popular containerization platform, written almost entirely in Go
- **Kubernetes** — Google's enterprise-scale container orchestration system
- **Uber** — ride-hailing backend handling millions of requests per second
- **Cloudflare** — CDN and internet security infrastructure
- **Dropbox** — cloud storage service

## Comparison: Go vs Python vs Java

| Aspect | Go | Python | Java |
|---|---|---|---|
| Execution speed | Very fast | Slow | Fast |
| Syntax | Simple | Very simple | Verbose |
| Concurrency | Native goroutines | GIL (limited) | JVM threads |
| Build output | Native binary | Interpreted | JVM bytecode |
| Type system | Static | Dynamic | Static |
| Deployment | Single binary | Needs Python runtime | Needs JVM |
| Learning curve | Gentle | Very gentle | Steep |

## First Program: Hello World

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
}
```

**Output:**
```
Hello, World!
```

Every executable Go program must have three components:
1. `package main` — marks this as a directly runnable program
2. `import` — imports external packages needed
3. `func main()` — the main function as the program entry point
